cohort: 279 maternal deaths at a tertiary care hospital in Hyderabad, Pakistan from June 2018 to June 2020.
finding: Hemorrhage (29.4%), eclampsia (16.13%), ruptured uterus (8.6%), and sepsis (5.73%) were the leading causes of maternal mortality, with the highest mortality rate observed in women aged 26-30 (40.50%).
